checks.name: typing_strength_review
checks.detail: Known publication/job/review/caller envelopes are TypedDicts; legacy/durable and absent/present caller branches are discriminated; public handoff overloads retain both views. Existing runtime validators precede refinement casts. Dispatch and import keys remain distinct from observation results. Reviewed manually against diff.

checks.name: minimal_runtime_refinements_review
checks.detail: UTC offset bound once; equivalent durable-job guard and assertions after guards; dispatch assembles a new equivalent dict; validated request returns its original object; typed caller integration branch preserves the schema-permitted cases; HTTP durable lookup uses its mandatory discriminator. No new defaults or provider operations.

limits: Independent source/AST review and 13 local caller-validation comparisons only; no full suite, publication trial, model, provider or artistic/human acceptance.
Static types do not establish runtime provenance or exact integer semantics; bool remains a subtype of int for static typing.
Record.fields, provider request/journal payloads and PLAR/lineage/delivery extensions remain deliberately dynamic; the closed envelopes do not claim those internals are statically complete.
Optional delivery/resume/member fields are NotRequired; their presence correlations still rely on runtime construction and existing behavior tests.
M1/M2 and broader M3/M4/M5 remain open.
